summary: Backend role-isolation regression passed; desktop Master Admin UI passed, but logout breaks the React app before the owner flow can load.

ui_bugs.issue: Logging out from Master Admin causes an uncaught React runtime error overlay: 'destroy is not a function', preventing the login screen/owner workspace from rendering in the same session.

integration_issues.flow: Master Admin logout -> Fresh Mart owner login
integration_issues.issue: Flow stops after logout because ClientWorkspace's useEffect(load, []) returns the Promise from load; React treats it as an effect cleanup function.

action_items: Change ClientWorkspace useEffect to a synchronous effect callback that invokes load() without returning its Promise, then retest logout and owner workspace flows.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientWorkspace line 30 uses useEffect(load, []), while load returns axios Promise; React 18 development cleanup invokes the Promise as destroy().
Several secondary navigation modules and refresh/settings controls are placeholders or have no handler; not exercised as core operations.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (admin desktop pass; owner/mobile blocked by runtime error)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST Role Isolation Item and TEST UI Product; order FM-10243 was advanced to PICKING during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login, admin overview/client list, role endpoint restrictions, cookie auth, tenant derivation, product POST, order PATCH, and logout API passed. Browser logout from admin reproduced destroy-is-not-a-function overlay before owner UI.
rca of the issue: Reproduce: login as admin in browser, click [data-testid=logout-button], then observe uncaught overlay. In App.js ClientWorkspace defines load = () => api.get(...).then(...), which returns a Promise, and passes it directly to useEffect(load, []). React expects an optional cleanup function, later calls the Promise as destroy, and throws TypeError. Wrap the call in useEffect(() => { load(); }, []).
